title: The feedback inbox accepts a roadmap step as a task home
why: Triage files the owner's tasks as roadmap steps, but hook feedback_guard accepts only docs/todo.md or docs/debts as a task home. Triage then marks the item as a note, which hides that it is a task (Nov 1 19:05 CST, items fb-1902-1 and fb-1902-2).
note:
Nov 6 12:01 CST (coordinator replan: Opus plan and critic, main 7975f6d8, roadmap 01995020): DONE, evidence on main: feedback_guard roadmap:<slug>.
Fix: feedback_guard accepts roadmap:<slug> as a task home when that step file exists on the repo's record branch (read with git show origin/roadmap:roadmap/data/steps/<slug>.json, no new process). Red first: roadmap:<slug> for an existing step passes; for a missing slug it is refused. Basis: measured, two refusals this turn. Port: yes, every repo with a roadmap. Ready.
